title: Storm-lit Night of Secrets
premise: A storm rages as a young girl ascends a lighthouse with a lamp and an unread letter.
ledger: You are the niece of the lighthouse keeper, entrusted with delivering the lamp and letter.
You carry a single lantern and an unopened letter in your satchel.
The lighthouse stands tall against the tumultuous sea, its beacon flickering in the storm.
opening: Rain lashes the windows as you climb the narrow spiral staircase, each step a battle against the wind that threatens to push you back. The lantern's light dims and brightens with the gusts, casting long, wavering shadows. The letter in your satchel feels heavier with each step, its contents unknown and its purpose urgent. You reach a landing and pause, the sound of the storm deafening. Ahead, the staircase continues its ascent, leading to the lantern room where the lighthouse keeper awaits. You must choose: continue upward to fulfill your task or seek shelter from the raging storm below.
